WHAT'S YOUR RETURN AND REFUND POLICY?
Our return window is 14 DAYS AFTER YOU RECEIVE THE ITEM. To be eligible, the item must be in ORIGINAL CONDITION, UNWORN OR UNUSED, with TAGS ATTACHED, in the ORIGINAL PACKAGING, and you’ll need the RECEIPT OR PROOF OF PURCHASE.
A few key policy details:
- $9.99 RESTOCKING FEE is deducted from each refund.
- Items returned with MAKEUP, SELF-TANNER, DEODORANT, PET HAIR, OR STAINS are processed for STORE CREDIT ONLY.
- FINAL-SALE ITEMS are also STORE CREDIT ONLY.
- NON-RETURNABLE ITEMS: international orders EXCEPT CANADA, intimates, bodysuits, jewelry, all markdown/sale items, and gift cards.
- Once we RECEIVE AND INSPECT your return, your refund is issued to the ORIGINAL PAYMENT METHOD WITHIN 10 BUSINESS DAYS, though your bank may take additional time to post it.
To start a return, exchange, or label request, please use our return portal:
HTTPS://NAKEDWARDROBE.COM/APPS/AFTERSHIP-RETURNS-CENTER
